notes: The page prints its content rotated on a portrait page and the page label '6 - 6' is rotated with it. The table was read from a 400 dpi render rotated into reading orientation.
A printed tick mark is transcribed as ✓; a blank printed cell is an empty string. Ticks are printed in slanted hand-set form, not as a checked box.
No Source line is printed for this table.
The table ends on this page: page 530 carries Figure 6.3 a 'Types of sludge pumps' and does not continue Table 6.5, although the baseline index records page_end 530 for this unit.
Printed pump names are retained, including 'Archimedean screw', 'Double diaphragm', 'Progressive cavity', 'Reciprocating piston', 'Rotary-lobe', 'Screw centrifugal' and 'Torque flow'.
The printed header is 'No' without a full stop; retained. The six sludge-type headings are each printed on two lines and joined with spaces.

Rows 7 and 8 print ticks only in the thickened and digested sludge columns; row 9 prints a single tick under Primary sludge; row 11 prints ticks in four columns but none under Thickened sludge. All are retained as printed.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page renders and 260-800 dpi crops of the same pages; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All eleven rows and six tick columns read from a 200 dpi rotated page view and then re-read row by row from four 400 dpi rotated bands (rows 1-2, 3-8, 9-11); each tick was confirmed against its column rule on the high-resolution bands.
